description: Placement group assign: the assign POST once confirmed. Confirm-gate text, group_id validation text, and the linodes-array messages all diverge, so only the success path is pinned (see report). A success body that is not a JSON object must fail rather than turn into a zeroed placement-group record.

cases.name: assigns Linodes to a placement group
requires confirm
cases.expect_error: This assigns Linodes to a placement group. Set confirm=true to proceed.

cases.name: rejects a numeric API response
cases.expect_api_error: Failed to assign Linodes to placement group

cases.name: rejects a boolean API response
cases.expect_api_error: Failed to assign Linodes to placement group

cases.name: rejects a populated-array API response
cases.expect_api_error: Failed to assign Linodes to placement group
